events.title: C# programming language announced
events.summary: Microsoft announced C# alongside the .NET vision at Forum 2000 as a modern managed language for Windows and web services.
events.about: C# is Microsoft's main language for .NET — garbage-collected, type-safe, C-like syntax. Used for Windows desktop apps (WPF/WinForms), ASP.NET websites and APIs, Unity game development, and enterprise services. Example: a line-of-business app talking to SQL Server, or a cross-platform game in Unity.

narrative.whyChosen: C# became the primary language of .NET and a major enterprise and game-dev (Unity) platform.
narrative.whyImportant: It combined C++-familiar syntax with garbage collection and a unified type system for the CLR.
narrative.problemSolved: Microsoft needed a flagship managed language for XML web services and safer Windows development.
